```{=html}
<style>
.arma-lab {
  --surface-1: #fcfcfb;
  --surface-2: #f3f2ef;
  --border: #dedcd6;
  --text-primary: #0b0b0b;
  --text-secondary: #52514e;
  --text-muted: #7a7974;
  --ink: #3b3a37;          /* sample ACF/PACF lollipops (like fpp3) */
  --model: #eb6834;        /* what the chosen ARMA(p,q) explains */
  --resid: #2a78d6;        /* residuals */
  --band: #2a78d6;         /* significance bounds */
  --alert: #e34948;        /* residual spike outside the bounds */
  --good: #008300;
  font-family: inherit;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--surface-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 16px 18px 12px;
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
}
.arma-lab h4 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.arma-lab .sub { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: .88rem; margin: 0 0 12px; }
.arma-lab .controls {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 16px; align-items: center;
  background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.arma-lab .controls label { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--text-secondary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.arma-lab .order { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; }
.arma-lab .order button {
  border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: .88rem; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-primary);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.arma-lab .order button:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.arma-lab .order button.on { background: var(--text-primary); color: #fff; }
.arma-lab .btn {
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: #fff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 12px;
  font-size: .88rem; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-primary);
}
.arma-lab .btn:hover, .arma-lab .order button:hover:not(.on) { background: #eceae5; }
.arma-lab .spacer { flex: 1; }
.arma-lab .row { margin-top: 10px; }
.arma-lab .row-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.arma-lab .row-head b { font-size: .95rem; }
.arma-lab .row-head span { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.arma-lab .grid3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .arma-lab .grid3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.arma-lab .modelbox { font-size: .84rem; color: var(--text-secondary); padding: 6px 4px 0 4px; line-height: 1.45; }
.arma-lab .modelbox .eq { display: block; margin: 4px 0 8px; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 6px; line-height: 1.6; }
.arma-lab svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.arma-lab svg text { font-size: 10px; fill: var(--text-muted); }
.arma-lab svg text.ttl { font-size: 11px; fill: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 600; }
.arma-lab .legend { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 2px 0 0; }
.arma-lab .legend i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: -1px; }
.arma-lab .legend i.line { width: 14px; height: 0; border-radius: 0; border-top: 2px dashed var(--band); vertical-align: 3px; }
.arma-lab .eq { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--text-primary); }
.arma-lab .verdict { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 18px; align-items: center; font-size: .88rem; margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2); }
.arma-lab .verdict .tag { font-weight: 600; }
.arma-lab .verdict .tag.ok { color: var(--good); }
.arma-lab .verdict .tag.bad { color: var(--alert); }
.arma-lab .truth { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.arma-lab .truth b { color: var(--text-primary); }
.arma-lab .tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: #0b0b0b; color: #fff; font-size: 12px;
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 5px; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .08s; z-index: 10; }
</style>

<div class="arma-lab" id="arma-lab">
  <h4>ARMA identification lab</h4>
  <p class="sub">A mystery series is generated from a random AR, MA or ARMA process. Read its ACF and PACF, choose the AR order (p) and MA order (q), and watch what your model takes out of the series and what it leaves behind in the errors.</p>

  <div class="controls">
    <label>AR order (p) <span class="order" data-k="p"></span></label>
    <label>MA order (q) <span class="order" data-k="q"></span></label>
    <span class="spacer"></span>
    <button class="btn" data-act="reveal">Reveal true process</button>
    <button class="btn" data-act="new">New mystery series</button>
  </div>

  <div class="row">
    <div class="row-head"><b>1 · The series</b><span>Bars: sample ACF/PACF of the data. Orange dots: the part your ARMA(p,q) accounts for.</span></div>
    <div class="grid3"><div data-plot="y"></div><div data-plot="yacf"></div><div data-plot="ypacf"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="row">
    <div class="row-head"><b>2 · Your model</b><span>The correlation pattern your chosen ARMA(p,q) can reproduce (fitted to the data).</span></div>
    <div class="grid3"><div class="modelbox" data-out="eq"></div><div data-plot="macf"></div><div data-plot="mpacf"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="row">
    <div class="row-head"><b>3 · What is left in the errors</b><span>Residuals of your model. Anything you did not model shows up here.</span></div>
    <div class="grid3"><div data-plot="e"></div><div data-plot="eacf"></div><div data-plot="epacf"></div></div>
    <div class="verdict" data-out="verdict"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="legend">
    <span><i style="background:var(--ink)"></i>Series</span>
    <span><i style="background:var(--model)"></i>Implied by your model</span>
    <span><i style="background:var(--resid)"></i>Residuals</span>
    <span><i style="background:var(--alert)"></i>Residual spike outside bounds</span>
    <span><i class="line"></i>±1.96/√T significance bounds</span>
  </div>
  <p class="truth" data-out="truth"></p>
  <div class="tip"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('arma-lab');
  if (!root) return;
  const T = 300, LAGS = 20, LB_LAG = 10, MAXORD = 3;
  const W = 300, H = 150, M = { l: 30, r: 8, t: 18, b: 20 };
  const css = getComputedStyle(root);
  const C = k => css.getPropertyValue('--' + k).trim();
  const tip = root.querySelector('.tip');

  // ---------- random numbers ----------
  const randn = () => { let u = 0, v = 0; while (!u) u = Math.random(); while (!v) v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v); };
  const unif = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * Math.random();
  const sgn = () => (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);

  // ---------- partial autocorrelations <-> coefficients (keeps AR stationary / MA invertible) ----------
  function kappaToPoly(kap) {          // Levinson recursion: returns a with 1 - a1 z - ... having roots outside unit circle
    let a = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < kap.length; k++) {
      const n = a.slice();
      for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) n[j] = a[j] - kap[k] * a[k - 1 - j];
      n[k] = kap[k]; a = n;
    }
    return a;
  }

  // ---------- simulate ARMA ----------
  function simulate(phi, theta, n) {
    const burn = 200, N = n + burn, y = new Array(N).fill(0), e = new Array(N);
    for (let t = 0; t < N; t++) {
      e[t] = randn();
      let v = e[t];
      for (let i = 0; i < phi.length; i++) if (t - 1 - i >= 0) v += phi[i] * y[t - 1 - i];
      for (let j = 0; j < theta.length; j++) if (t - 1 - j >= 0) v += theta[j] * e[t - 1 - j];
      y[t] = v;
    }
    return y.slice(burn);
  }

  // ---------- ACF / PACF ----------
  function acf(x, K) {
    const n = x.length, m = x.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
    let d = 0; for (const v of x) d += (v - m) ** 2;
    const r = [];
    for (let k = 1; k <= K; k++) { let s = 0; for (let t = 0; t < n - k; t++) s += (x[t] - m) * (x[t + k] - m); r.push(s / d); }
    return r;
  }
  function pacfFromAcf(r) {            // Durbin-Levinson; r = [rho1..rhoK]
    const K = r.length, out = []; let prev = [];
    for (let k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
      let num = r[k - 1], den = 1;
      for (let j = 1; j < k; j++) { num -= prev[j - 1] * r[k - 1 - j]; den -= prev[j - 1] * r[j - 1]; }
      const pkk = num / den, cur = [];
      for (let j = 1; j < k; j++) cur.push(prev[j - 1] - pkk * prev[k - 1 - j]);
      cur.push(pkk); out.push(pkk); prev = cur;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function theoAcf(phi, theta, K) {    // via psi weights
    const J = 600, psi = [1];
    for (let j = 1; j < J; j++) {
      let v = j <= theta.length ? theta[j - 1] : 0;
      for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(j, phi.length); i++) v += phi[i - 1] * psi[j - i];
      psi.push(v);
    }
    const g = k => { let s = 0; for (let j = 0; j + k < J; j++) s += psi[j] * psi[j + k]; return s; };
    const g0 = g(0), r = [];
    for (let k = 1; k <= K; k++) r.push(g(k) / g0);
    return r;
  }

  // ---------- fit ARMA(p,q) by conditional sum of squares ----------
  function residuals(z, phi, theta) {
    const n = z.length, e = new Array(n).fill(0);
    for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) {
      let v = z[t];
      for (let i = 0; i < phi.length; i++) if (t - 1 - i >= 0) v -= phi[i] * z[t - 1 - i];
      for (let j = 0; j < theta.length; j++) if (t - 1 - j >= 0) v -= theta[j] * e[t - 1 - j];
      e[t] = v;
    }
    return e;
  }
  function unpack(u, p, q) {
    const phi = kappaToPoly(u.slice(0, p).map(Math.tanh));
    const theta = kappaToPoly(u.slice(p).map(Math.tanh)).map(v => -v);
    return { phi, theta };
  }
  function nelderMead(f, x0, iters) {
    const n = x0.length; if (!n) return x0;
    let S = [x0.slice()];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = x0.slice(); x[i] += 0.5; S.push(x); }
    let F = S.map(f);
    for (let it = 0; it < iters; it++) {
      const idx = F.map((v, i) => i).sort((a, b) => F[a] - F[b]); S = idx.map(i => S[i]); F = idx.map(i => F[i]);
      if (Math.abs(F[n] - F[0]) < 1e-10 * (1 + Math.abs(F[0]))) break;
      const c = new Array(n).fill(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) c[j] += S[i][j] / n;
      const pt = a => c.map((v, j) => v + a * (S[n][j] - v));
      const xr = pt(-1), fr = f(xr);
      if (fr < F[0]) { const xe = pt(-2), fe = f(xe); if (fe < fr) { S[n] = xe; F[n] = fe; } else { S[n] = xr; F[n] = fr; } }
      else if (fr < F[n - 1]) { S[n] = xr; F[n] = fr; }
      else {
        const xc = pt(0.5), fc = f(xc);
        if (fc < F[n]) { S[n] = xc; F[n] = fc; }
        else for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { S[i] = S[i].map((v, j) => S[0][j] + 0.5 * (v - S[0][j])); F[i] = f(S[i]); }
      }
    }
    let b = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (F[i] < F[b]) b = i;
    return S[b];
  }
  function fit(y, p, q) {
    const mu = y.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / y.length, z = y.map(v => v - mu);
    const sse = u => { const { phi, theta } = unpack(u, p, q); const e = residuals(z, phi, theta);
      let s = 0; for (let t = p; t < e.length; t++) s += e[t] * e[t]; return s; };
    let best = null;
    const starts = [new Array(p + q).fill(0), new Array(p + q).fill(0).map(() => unif(-1, 1)), new Array(p + q).fill(0).map(() => unif(-1, 1))];
    for (const s of starts) { const u = nelderMead(sse, s, 1500), v = sse(u); if (!best || v < best.v) best = { u, v }; }
    const { phi, theta } = unpack(best.u, p, q);
    const e = residuals(z, phi, theta).slice(p);
    const n = e.length, k = p + q + 1;
    const bic = n * Math.log(best.v / n) + k * Math.log(n);
    return { mu, phi, theta, e, bic };
  }

  // ---------- Ljung-Box ----------
  function lnGamma(x) { const c = [76.18009172947146, -86.50532032941677, 24.01409824083091, -1.231739572450155, 0.1208650973866179e-2, -0.5395239384953e-5];
    let y = x, t = x + 5.5; t -= (x + 0.5) * Math.log(t); let s = 1.000000000190015; for (const v of c) s += v / ++y; return -t + Math.log(2.5066282746310005 * s / x); }
  function gammaQ(a, x) {             // upper regularized incomplete gamma
    if (x <= 0) return 1;
    if (x < a + 1) { let ap = a, sum = 1 / a, del = sum; for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { ap++; del *= x / ap; sum += del; if (Math.abs(del) < Math.abs(sum) * 1e-12) break; }
      return 1 - sum * Math.exp(-x + a * Math.log(x) - lnGamma(a)); }
    let b = x + 1 - a, c = 1e300, d = 1 / b, h = d;
    for (let i = 1; i < 300; i++) { const an = -i * (i - a); b += 2; d = an * d + b; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-300) d = 1e-300; c = b + an / c; if (Math.abs(c) < 1e-300) c = 1e-300; d = 1 / d; const del = d * c; h *= del; if (Math.abs(del - 1) < 1e-12) break; }
    return Math.exp(-x + a * Math.log(x) - lnGamma(a)) * h;
  }
  function ljungBox(r, n, h, df) { let Q = 0; for (let k = 1; k <= h; k++) Q += r[k - 1] ** 2 / (n - k); Q *= n * (n + 2);
    return { Q, p: gammaQ(Math.max(df, 1) / 2, Q / 2) }; }

  // ---------- random "true" process ----------
  function randomProcess() {
    const kinds = ['AR1', 'AR1', 'AR2', 'MA1', 'MA1', 'MA2', 'ARMA11', 'WN'];
    const kind = kinds[Math.floor(Math.random() * kinds.length)];
    const k1 = () => sgn() * unif(0.5, 0.85);
    let phi = [], theta = [];
    if (kind === 'AR1') phi = [k1()];
    if (kind === 'AR2') phi = kappaToPoly([sgn() * unif(0.4, 0.8), sgn() * unif(0.45, 0.75)]);
    if (kind === 'MA1') theta = [k1()];
    if (kind === 'MA2') theta = kappaToPoly([sgn() * unif(0.4, 0.8), sgn() * unif(0.45, 0.75)]).map(v => -v);
    if (kind === 'ARMA11') { do { phi = [k1()]; theta = [sgn() * unif(0.4, 0.8)]; } while (Math.abs(phi[0] + theta[0]) < 0.7); }
    return { phi, theta };
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  function el(tag, attrs, parent) { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if (parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
  function svg(title) { const s = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: 'img', 'aria-label': title });
    el('text', { x: M.l, y: 11, class: 'ttl' }, s).textContent = title; return s; }
  function showTip(evt, html) { const b = root.getBoundingClientRect(); tip.innerHTML = html; tip.style.opacity = 1;
    tip.style.left = (evt.clientX - b.left + 12) + 'px'; tip.style.top = (evt.clientY - b.top - 28) + 'px'; }
  function hideTip() { tip.style.opacity = 0; }

  function corrPlot(host, title, vals, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const s = svg(title), pw = W - M.l - M.r, ph = H - M.t - M.b;
    const bound = 1.96 / Math.sqrt(opts.n || T);
    let ymax = opts.ymax || Math.max(0.3, bound * 1.4, ...vals.map(Math.abs), ...(opts.overlay || []).map(Math.abs));
    ymax = Math.min(1, Math.ceil(ymax * 10) / 10);
    const y = v => M.t + ph / 2 - (v / ymax) * (ph / 2), x = k => M.l + (k - 0.5) * pw / LAGS;
    // grid / axes
    for (const v of [-ymax, 0, ymax]) {
      el('line', { x1: M.l, x2: W - M.r, y1: y(v), y2: y(v), stroke: v === 0 ? C('text-muted') : C('border'), 'stroke-width': 1 }, s);
      el('text', { x: M.l - 4, y: y(v) + 3, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, s).textContent = v.toFixed(1);
    }
    for (const k of [1, 5, 10, 15, 20]) el('text', { x: x(k), y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'middle' }, s).textContent = k;
    for (const v of [bound, -bound]) el('line', { x1: M.l, x2: W - M.r, y1: y(v), y2: y(v), stroke: C('band'), 'stroke-width': 1.2, 'stroke-dasharray': '4 3' }, s);
    // bars
    vals.forEach((v, i) => {
      const k = i + 1, out = Math.abs(v) > bound;
      const col = opts.color === 'resid' ? (out ? C('alert') : C('resid')) : C(opts.color || 'ink');
      el('line', { x1: x(k), x2: x(k), y1: y(0), y2: y(v), stroke: col, 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linecap': 'round' }, s);
    });
    // overlay (model-implied)
    if (opts.overlay) opts.overlay.forEach((v, i) => el('circle', { cx: x(i + 1), cy: y(v), r: 3.6, fill: C('model'), stroke: C('surface-1'), 'stroke-width': 1.5 }, s));
    // hover targets
    vals.forEach((v, i) => {
      const k = i + 1, r = el('rect', { x: x(k) - pw / LAGS / 2, y: M.t, width: pw / LAGS, height: ph, fill: 'transparent' }, s);
      let html = `Lag ${k}: <b>${v.toFixed(3)}</b>`;
      if (opts.overlay) html += `<br>model: ${opts.overlay[i].toFixed(3)}`;
      if (Math.abs(v) > bound) html += `<br>outside ±${bound.toFixed(3)}`;
      r.addEventListener('mousemove', ev => showTip(ev, html)); r.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip);
    });
    host.replaceChildren(s);
  }

  function linePlot(host, title, v, color) {
    const s = svg(title), pw = W - M.l - M.r, ph = H - M.t - M.b, n = v.length;
    const lo = Math.min(...v), hi = Math.max(...v), pad = (hi - lo) * 0.05 || 1;
    const y = a => M.t + ph - (a - lo + pad) / (hi - lo + 2 * pad) * ph, x = i => M.l + i * pw / (n - 1);
    const ticks = [lo, (lo + hi) / 2, hi];
    for (const t of ticks) { el('line', { x1: M.l, x2: W - M.r, y1: y(t), y2: y(t), stroke: C('border') }, s);
      el('text', { x: M.l - 4, y: y(t) + 3, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, s).textContent = (Math.abs(t) < 0.05 ? 0 : t).toFixed(1); }
    el('text', { x: M.l, y: H - 6 }, s).textContent = '1';
    el('text', { x: W - M.r, y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, s).textContent = n;
    el('path', { d: v.map((a, i) => (i ? 'L' : 'M') + x(i).toFixed(1) + ' ' + y(a).toFixed(1)).join(''), fill: 'none', stroke: C(color), 'stroke-width': 1.2, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }, s);
    host.replaceChildren(s);
  }

  // ---------- state & render ----------
  let truth, y, yacf, ypacf, revealed = false;
  const state = { p: 0, q: 0 };
  const plot = k => root.querySelector(`[data-plot="${k}"]`), out = k => root.querySelector(`[data-out="${k}"]`);
  const fmt = v => (v >= 0 ? '+ ' : '− ') + Math.abs(v).toFixed(2);
  const name = (p, q, truth) => p && q ? `ARMA(${p},${q})` : p ? `AR(${p})` : q ? `MA(${q})` : truth ? 'White noise' : 'mean-only model';
  function equation(mu, phi, theta) {
    let s = `y<sub>t</sub> = ${mu.toFixed(2)}`;
    phi.forEach((v, i) => s += ` ${fmt(v)}·(y<sub>t−${i + 1}</sub> − μ)`);
    theta.forEach((v, j) => s += ` ${fmt(v)}·e<sub>t−${j + 1}</sub>`);
    return s;
  }

  function newSeries() {
    truth = randomProcess();
    const mu = Math.round(unif(-5, 20));
    // Redraw (rarely needed) so that the true model itself leaves white-noise errors:
    // keeps the lesson clean despite the test's ~5% false-alarm rate.
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 25; tries++) {
      y = simulate(truth.phi, truth.theta, T).map(v => v + mu);
      const p0 = truth.phi.length, q0 = truth.theta.length, f0 = fit(y, p0, q0);
      if (ljungBox(acf(f0.e, LAGS), f0.e.length, LB_LAG, LB_LAG - p0 - q0).p > 0.1) break;
    }
    yacf = acf(y, LAGS); ypacf = pacfFromAcf(yacf);
    revealed = false;
    linePlot(plot('y'), 'Mystery series y', y, 'ink');
    render();
  }

  function render() {
    const { p, q } = state, f = fit(y, p, q);
    const macf = theoAcf(f.phi, f.theta, LAGS), mpacf = pacfFromAcf(macf);
    const eacf = acf(f.e, LAGS), epacf = pacfFromAcf(eacf), n = f.e.length, bound = 1.96 / Math.sqrt(n);
    // one shared y-scale for all six correlation panels, so rows can be compared directly
    const ymax = Math.max(0.3, ...[yacf, ypacf, macf, mpacf, eacf, epacf].flat().map(Math.abs));
    corrPlot(plot('yacf'), 'ACF of y', yacf, { overlay: macf, ymax });
    corrPlot(plot('ypacf'), 'PACF of y', ypacf, { overlay: mpacf, ymax });
    const zero = p + q === 0;
    corrPlot(plot('macf'), `ACF implied by your ${name(p, q)}`, macf, { color: 'model', ymax });
    corrPlot(plot('mpacf'), `PACF implied by your ${name(p, q)}`, mpacf, { color: 'model', ymax });
    out('eq').innerHTML = `<b style="color:var(--text-primary)">Fitted ${name(p, q)}${zero ? ' (ARMA(0,0))' : ''}</b>` +
      `<span class="eq">${equation(f.mu, f.phi, f.theta)} + e<sub>t</sub></span>` +
      (zero ? 'No AR or MA terms: the model is only the mean, so it explains none of the correlation and the errors carry the whole pattern of the series.'
            : `The orange pattern is what these ${p + q} coefficient${p + q > 1 ? 's' : ''} can explain. Whatever part of the series ACF/PACF they cannot reproduce stays in the errors below.`);

    linePlot(plot('e'), 'Residuals e = y − ŷ', f.e, 'resid');
    corrPlot(plot('eacf'), 'ACF of residuals', eacf, { color: 'resid', n, ymax });
    corrPlot(plot('epacf'), 'PACF of residuals', epacf, { color: 'resid', n, ymax });

    const lb = ljungBox(eacf, n, LB_LAG, LB_LAG - p - q);
    const spikes = eacf.slice(0, LB_LAG).filter(v => Math.abs(v) > bound).length;
    const ok = lb.p > 0.05;
    out('verdict').innerHTML =
      `<span class="tag ${ok ? 'ok' : 'bad'}">${ok ? '✓ Errors look like white noise' : '✗ Pattern still left in the errors'}</span>` +
      `<span>Ljung-Box (lag ${LB_LAG}): Q = ${lb.Q.toFixed(1)}, p-value ${lb.p < 0.001 ? '< 0.001' : '= ' + lb.p.toFixed(3)}</span>` +
      `<span>ACF spikes outside bounds (lags 1–${LB_LAG}): ${spikes}</span>` +
      `<span>BIC: ${f.bic.toFixed(1)}</span>`;
    out('truth').innerHTML = revealed
      ? `True process: <b>${name(truth.phi.length, truth.theta.length, true)}</b>` +
        (truth.phi.length ? ` with φ = [${truth.phi.map(v => v.toFixed(2)).join(', ')}]` : '') +
        (truth.theta.length ? `${truth.phi.length ? ' and' : ' with'} θ = [${truth.theta.map(v => v.toFixed(2)).join(', ')}]` : '') +
        `. If two choices both leave white-noise errors, prefer the one with the lower BIC.`
      : 'Tip: start with p = 0 and q = 0, then add terms one at a time and watch the residual spikes disappear.';
  }

  // controls
  root.querySelectorAll('.order').forEach(box => {
    const k = box.dataset.k;
    for (let i = 0; i <= MAXORD; i++) {
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = i;
      if (i === state[k]) b.classList.add('on');
      b.addEventListener('click', () => { state[k] = i; box.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b)); render(); });
      box.appendChild(b);
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('[data-act="new"]').addEventListener('click', newSeries);
  root.querySelector('[data-act="reveal"]').addEventListener('click', () => { revealed = true; render(); });
  newSeries();
})();
</script>
```
